title: Thomas Edison
text:
Thomas Edison was a famous inventor. He was born in 1847 in the United States. He made many useful things, like the light bulb. Many people still use his ideas today.

Edison did not stay at school for very long. His mother taught him at home, and he loved reading books. He often worked late at night in his laboratory. He tested many ideas before the light bulb worked well.

questions.text: What kind of person was Edison most likely to be?
options: Shy and afraid of new ideas

questions.text: What can we guess about the light bulb?
options: It needed many tests before it worked well
It was finished in one day
It was made by his mother
It was not useful to people

vocabulary.definition: a person who creates a new machine or device
helpful and able to be used for a purpose
a room where scientific tests and experiments are done

paragraph_translations: Thomas Edison ünlü bir mucitti. 1847 yılında Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'nde doğdu. Ampul gibi birçok faydalı şey yaptı. Birçok insan bugün hâlâ onun fikirlerini kullanıyor.
Edison okulda çok uzun süre kalmadı. Annesi onu evde eğitti ve kitap okumayı çok severdi. Geceleri geç saatlere kadar laboratuvarında çalışırdı. Ampul iyi çalışmadan önce birçok fikri test etti.
